messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "tell your eye surgeon ahead of time that you are using this medication"
set: ["tell your eye surgeon ahead of time that you are using this medication", "if you need surgery, tell the surgeon ahead of time that you are using carvedilol", "tell surgeon ahead of time if needing surgery", "tell any doctor who treats you that you are using this medicine", "tell your eye surgeon you take or have taken it", "tell any doctor treating you that you are using buspirone", "tell any doctor who treats you that you are using empagliflozin", "tell your surgeon before any operation", "if you are being treated for high blood pressure, keep using this medication", "be sure caregivers know ahead of time", "tell your doctor if you are of chinese descent", "tell your doctor if you are pregnant", "tell surgeon and anesthetist you take it", "tell any doctor who treats you that you are taking apixaban", "this medication guide", "tell your doctor if you are fasting or vomiting, because this raises your risk of low blood sugar"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
